programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: Yusei wakes up to find himself trapped in the back of a big rig with a bump on his head and no way out. After a mysterious tip leads Akiza to Yusei's location, the two friends soon find themselves Turbo Dueling an unfamiliar foe.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: As the battle between Yusei and Sherry races on, Sherry reveals some shocking secrets about the upcoming World Racing Grand Prix. Meanwhile, Akiza begins to gain a new understanding and appreciation for Turbo Dueling while riding shotgun to Yusei.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: Before heading out to the event of the year - The World Racing Grand Prix Gala - Yusei challenges Jack to a Turbo Duel in the hopes of finding a new dueling strategy that doesn't involve the use of Synchro Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: A mysterious duelist named Vizor offers to show Yusei a new dueling strategy known as The Synchro Solution.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: Akiza goes to get her Turbo Dueling license, but before she can drive off into the sunset, she first has to out-duel, out-maneuver and out-smart one of Sector Security's finest for her final exam.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: After a string of Duel Runner thefts has New Domino City on high alert, Jack Atlas decides to take justice into his own hands and ventures out in search of those responsible.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: When a mysterious new student gives Luna a-one-of-a-kind Duel Board, Leo, trusting his instincts, steps up and tries to pull a 180 on their friendship.
programme.sub-title: Dawn of the Duel Board: Part I

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: As the Duel Board battle between Leo, Luna and the mystery duelist continues, Leo soon realizes that their mysterious opponent is actually an all-too-familiar friend.
programme.sub-title: Dawn of the Duel Board: Part II

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: Jack and Crow set out to find a restless Yusei - hoping to ease his mind and reinforce the friendship they share by Turbo Dueling down memory lane.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: A mysterious amnesiac helps Yusei build a new engine program for his Runner, but before they can test it out, a make-up-wearing, noodle-eating crook runs off with the file.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: Yusei and the gang trail Lazar to the local mall hoping to reacquire the engine design program that this window-shopping, noodle-eating crook stole from them.
programme.sub-title: Get With the Program: Part I

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: Yusei and Lazar are trapped in a warehouse where their only chance of escaping is if Yusei can outduel a Guard Bot whose CPU has been uploaded with all of Yusei's battle techniques.
programme.sub-title: Get With the Program: Part II

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: After being charged with crimes he didn't commit, Jack Atlas scrambles to uncover the truth before his friends and fans turn their back on him for good.
programme.sub-title: Will The Real Jack Atlas, Please Stand Up: Part I

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: With Jack Atlas on the run, Yusei and Crow set out in search of their pal, hoping to clear his good name before bad turns to worse.
programme.sub-title: Will The Real Jack Atlas, Please Stand Up: Part II

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: When Zora's stubborn son Leon suddenly returns home, Crow picks a duel with him to help him realize that the ongoing quarrel he has with his mother is much ado about nothing.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: When Yusei heads to a tumbleweed town at the request of some locals, he quickly finds himself in the middle of two feuding families - with his old friend Kalin right there with him!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: When Yusei challenges Kalin to a duel, he hopes to save his old acquaintance from a terrible fate. However, the dueling gets dicey when it becomes clear that Kalin doesn't necessarily want to be saved!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: As Yusei continues to duel his best to save Kalin from a most unhappy ending, he suddenly finds himself double crossed by his supposed allies and in desperate need of some saving of his own!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: After being double crossed and sent to the mines by his supposed allies, Yusei hatches a plan to escape. Can Yusei find a way out, or will he and Kalin be forced to work the mines forever?
programme.sub-title: The Race to Escape: Part I

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: It's a high-speed minecart chase as Kalin and Yusei scramble to rescue Sergio's family from the clutches of the Crash Town mine. When Lawton and his goons gain up on the fleeing family, things take a heartbreaking turn.
programme.sub-title: The Race to Escape: Part II

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: The sinister Lawton has captured West and Nico and gained control of Crash Town, but Yusei and Kalin have no intention of letting him get away with it. It's the ultimate showdown as the dueling duo confront Lawton in a winner-takes-all battle.
programme.sub-title: Clash at Crash Town: Part I

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: As the clash between Lawton, Yusei and Kalin comes to a climactic close, Yusei and Kalin must figure out a way to defeat Lawton before his deck destroys their dreams of freeing everyone in the mines.
programme.sub-title: Clash at Crash Town: Part II

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: When Sherry breaks into a city building in search of answers about a very special duel card, she finds a lot more than she bargained for.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: When Crow looks to avenge a missing colleague, he ends up finding an old friend who turns out not to be what he seems.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: Crow takes on an old friend in a duel to determine the truth about a colleague's mysterious disappearance.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: A little fender bender turns into a friendly duel when Crow smashes into one of Team Unicorn's duelists on the tournament practice lanes only this was no accident and Team Unicorn's intentions are anything but friendly.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: New threats are on the horizon and no one can be trusted. Sherry arrives to inform Yusei that she suspects the sinister forces of Iliaster have infiltrated the tournament.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: Can Jack and his power-packed deck bring down his opponent or will Andre's secret plan place Jack and Team 5D's on the brink of elimination?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: With Team Unicorn taking the early lead against Team 5D's, all eyes turn to Akiza as she takes to the track hoping to take down Andre and even up the score.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: With Jack and Akiza already defeated, Yusei finds himself having to defeat all three members of Team Unicorn on his own. Can Yusei come up with a comeback that will wrangle the win away from Team Unicorn?
programme.sub-title: The Edge of Elimination: Part I

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
programme.desc: Yusei must figure out a way to defeat all three members of Team Unicorn before his deck is drained of all its duel cards.
programme.sub-title: The Edge of Elimination: Part II

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Things get a little wild with a very passionate guest named Wanda. Her daughter, Tiffany, told her mother she ruined her wedding, among many other things. programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

The temptations and pressure exerted on Chris by Toni to return to their former carefree life of sex, drugs and rock'n'roll soon starts to have an impact on Chris's marriage. He starts to question his values, his lifestyle choices and his relationship with Marion and even suspects her of starting an affair with Toni whom she dislikes! programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Season 1 finishes on a high note when rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6 – time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys have Federated’s 1990 454SS Project Truck in house and they’re doing a ton of work to it. From brakes and shocks to chassis work, this truck needs some love.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys tackle a steering issue in this supped up Jeep by replacing the worn-out power steering gear and installing a new power steering cooler. They toss in a few extras for the owner as well.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys help a 2009 Challenger owner add a little more get up and go to her car. Willie also sets up a trade deal with a ’70 Cuda owner to help get his car a little closer to restoration time.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: We’ve got a bright yellow C7 in the shop today and Kevin and Willie are installing new specialized long tube headers, exhaust and other extras to make this already robust platform even more powerful.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Fuller dreams of a life in Surf City, California and finds a garage of Dream Cars along the way.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Find out what goes into the electrical wiring on a new age Super Car….not as much as you might think.

programme.desc: Mark isolates himself in the machine-shop and begins the assembly of the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger previously owned by a former cast member.

programme.desc: With all the distractions out of the way, Mark returns to the machine-ship to finish the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger while master-assembler Dave begins working on the 1970 Lemon-Twist Roadrunner.

programme.desc: With Mark out of the shop looking at a potential new location for a Mopar car-dealership, the Graveyard Ghouls begin the drivetrain assembly’s for a 1970 Lime Light Tribute Superbird and our 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark the the Graveyard Ghouls race against the clock to finish up some last-minute tasks on their various Mopar restorations before traveling north to judge Little Creek Casino’s epic car show.

programme.desc: It’s another reveal day! Mark and Allysa install the graphics on the ’71 Plumb Crazy Challenger and the 1970 Lemon-Twist Roadrunner is finished and readied to be delivered to it’s owner. And Mark proposes - what he thinks is - a “brilliant” idea to the producers of the show.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With our 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger nearing completion, works shifts to our 1970 Tribute Superbird while Mark and Cousin Dougie build out a 340 engine and Will assists with metal work with George to help him stay on schedule.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s a special day at Graveyard Carz. The 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger that has been part of our show since its inception is finally finished and ready to be shipped to it’s new owner. But before they do that, they take it to the coast to show it off at Chinook Winds Casino Resort Car Show!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Work ramps up on our 1970 Tribute Superbird and just when things couldn’t get more stressful, Mark has taken on a new project - a 1969 GTX owned by non other than Chris Jacobs, host of Overhaulin’. Not only does Chris want the car restored to it’s former glory, he wants it to be completed in time for SEMA 2017 - only sixty days away!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Stress is high at the shop and things don’t get any better when Mark finds out that Tony from Tony’s Mopar Parts has secretly flown out to check in on the progress of his 1970 Challenger. Knowing that the restoration hasn’t started, Mark does everything in his power to distract Tony while Cousin Dougie races to disassemble his car.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: SEMA 2017 is fast approaching and the Graveyard Ghouls are working hard on Chris Jacob’s 1969 GTX and John Buck’s 1971 Challenger with a Hellcrate Hemi. But as pressure begins to mount, Mark questions if he’ll be able to keep his promised - and ultimately - is forced to make a difficult decision.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The Phoenix Cuda: A legendary Mopar which was incinerated and from the ashes, will be reborn at Graveyard Carz.

programme.desc: Graveyard Carz returns to conclude the epic builds of Chris Jacob’s 1968 GTX after it suffered a devastating fire, and the first of it’s kind 1970 Plymouth Superbird equipped with a Hellcat Crate Hemi.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: New Season, New Carz! With SEMA in their rear-view mirror, the ghouls begin the final assembly of a 1969 Plymouth GTX in Seafoam Turquoise. And when help comes up short-handed, Mark enlists what he likes to call his “Echo Bomber.”

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s the 100th Episode! Join Mark and Royal and watch the never-before-aired Pilot featuring some of the first Mopar restorations the original ghouls tackled over ten-years ago.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s a hectic day at the Graveyard. Dave jumps from car to car, installing and assembling what he can, Will struggles to keep focused on one project at a time, and Mark makes progress on his A100 build with the hopes of revealing at SEMA 2018!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Professional wrestler, actor, and former professional football player known for his time in the WWE and WCW as Goldberg returns to the Graveyard! programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno work on a truck that belongs to a tournament fisherman who uses his truck for work and play. It racks up a lot of miles. They are going to hook this boat captain up with some new products that will make his life a lot easier on the road!

programme.desc: Matt and Bruno are working on a 2006 Dodge Ram with a ton of problems…but why just make the repairs? Go better than stock!

programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: Gardiens du patrimoine

programme.title: Les a$ de la brocante

programme.title: La fièvre des encans: nouvelle génération
programme.desc: Notre trio se retrouve à l'église, où l'encanteur Alain Brousseau est en feu devant ses fidèles; la salle est pleine, ce qui annonce une forte compétition; nos acolytes travaillent en équipe pour maximiser la récolte.

programme.title: Les rois de la récup

In 1965, an Alabama city became the battleground in the fight for suffrage. Despite violent opposition, Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. (David Oyelowo) and his followers pressed forward on an epic march from Selma to Montgomery, and their efforts culminated with President Lyndon Johnson signing the Voting Rights Act of 1965.

After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity.

programme.desc: Ein harmloser Spieleabend endet mit einem verblüffenden Kampf, und während Kim und Kyle ausnahmsweise einer Meinung sind, steht Brandi allein da. Auch Camilles Wohltätigkeitslunch verläuft angespannt.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Taylor enthüllt die ungeschminkte Wahrheit über ihre Ehe, und Lisas Tochter Pandora heiratet in einer glamourösen "Millionen-Dollar-Zeremonie" auf dem Vanderpump-Anwesen.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of New York City
programme.desc: In Vorbereitung auf das neue Schuljahr geht Jill mit Allyson auf eine anstrengende Einkaufstour in eine teure Boutique in Manhattan. Dort stellt sie fest, dass es eine Million Dollar kostet, ein Kind in der Stadt großzuziehen. Ramona besucht eine Modenschau, auf der sie Jill begegnet. Es kommt zu Spannungen, als Jill bemerkt, dass Ramona im Gegensatz zu ihr in der ersten Reihe sitzt. Alex und Simon schenken Francois anlässlich seines ersten Tages im Kindergarten eine neue Schulmappe.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Camille organisiert bei sich in Malibu eine Dinnerparty. Zusätzlich zu den Housewives sind noch einige andere Gäste eingeladen, die die Stimmung ordentlich aufheizen. Die Situation eskaliert, und bald liegen sich nicht nur Kyle und Camille wegen ungeklärter Konflikte in den Haaren.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Nach dem New-York-Ausflug ist die Stimmung unter den Housewives immer noch angespannt. Lisa organisiert für Kim ein Date mit einem befreundeten Millionär. Kelsey wurde für den Tony Award nominiert, also lenkt Camille sich mit Shoppen ab und probiert sündhaft teure Kleider an.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: Kim und Shereé kehren zum "Tatort" beim FAB (?) zurück, um es wieder gut zu machen und eine Überraschungs-Verlobungsparty für Kandi und AJ zu planen. Shereés fertige Muster für ihre Kollektion "She by Shereé" kommen endlich an und sie zeigt sie Dwight zum ersten Mal. NeNe und ihr Onkel Mel reisen zu ihren Wurzeln in Athen, um Denene, der Co-Autorin ihres Buches, Einblick in ihr Leben als Kind zu geben.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: Sehen Sie sich bisher unveröffentlichte Szenen aus der zweiten Staffel von "The Real Housewives of Atlanta: Verlorenes Filmmaterial" an. Unter anderem zeigen wir einen skandalösen Bauchtanz-Unterricht, Kims Treffen mit einem Heiratsvermittler, Shereés Fitness-Video und mehr. Sehen Sie die Damen von ihrer besten - und lustigsten - Seite in dieser neuen, einstündigen Folge.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: Direkt nach ihrem Streit mit Kandi und Kim distanziert sich NeNe noch weiter von den Beiden. Kim und Kandi schließen gemeinsam die Aufnahme von "Tardy for the Party" gerade rechtzeitig für ihre gemeinsame Geburtstagsfeier ab, auf der Big Papa eine Überraschung für Kim hat. Shereé lässt Dwight ihre Modenschau organisieren, während sie mit Tania nach New York fliegt, um die Muster für "She by Shereé" anzusehen.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
programme.desc: Nach fast 2 Jahren steht "She by Shereé" kurz vor der Premiere, doch es zeichnen sich große Veränderungen ab und zwischen den Damen gärt es gewaltig. Während Lisa sich auf eine neue Zukunft ohne das NFL-Gehalt von Ed vorbereitet, erlebt Kandi endlich einen Durchbruch zwischen AJ und ihrer Mutter und Shereé muss ihre Nerven beruhigen, bevor ihre Kollektion auf dem Laufsteg präsentiert wird.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Camille lädt Kyle zum Schwimmen und Tennisspielen ein - ein unbeholfener Versuch, um ihre Freundschaft zu reparieren. Lisas Gast Cedric enthüllt Tragisches über seine Vergangenheit, und Kyle organisiert für Mauricios 40. Geburtstag eine White Party.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of New York City
programme.desc: Bethenny trifft sich mit Alex, um ihr beizubringen, wie sie für ihre Familie gesundes Essen kochen kann. Bethenny vertraut Alex an, dass sie Ärger mit Jason hat. Die van Kempens machen sie bereit für eine große Party. Ramona bereitet Avery und ihre Freunde auf einen Schulball vor.

programme.title: Im Rampenlicht - Football’s Greatest Stage - Ronaldo & Ferenc Puskas
programme.desc: Episode 1: Wenn Ronaldo zauberte, kam niemand an ihn heran. Wir verfolgen die turbulente Karriere eines der größten Spieler des Fußballs. Und dann war da noch Ferenc Puskas, der 1954 verletzt war und Ungarn in der Schweiz nicht zum Sieg führen konnte. Wir würdigen den russischen Torhüter Lew Jaschin - die schwarze Spinne ist bis heute der einzige Torhüter, der den Ballon d'Or gewonnen hat. Und wir werfen einen Blick auf Spanien 1982, wo Paolo Rossi, als es darauf ankam, Italien die dritte Weltmeisterschaft bescherte. Herzschmerz und Ekstase, in unserer ersten Folge von Football's Greatest Stage.

programme.title: Im Rampenlicht - Football’s Greatest Stage - Maradona & Luis Suarez
programme.desc: Episode 2: Er ist einer der größten Spieler aller Zeiten. Mit Fehlern behaftet, aber auf der ganzen Welt verehrt. Diego Maradonas Einfluss auf den Fußball ist unübertroffen. Die Weltmeisterschaft 1974, bei der Beckenbauer und Cruyff in Westdeutschland für Furore sorgten. Die Heldentaten des spanischen Nationalspielers Iker Casillas bis hin zum Schrecken des Bisses von Luis Suarez - dies ist die größte Bühne des Fußballs.

programme.title: Im Rampenlicht - Football’s Greatest Stage - Bobby Moore & Roger Milla
programme.desc: Episode 3: Die Geschichte von Englands Bobby Moore ist ebenso sehenswert wie die von Italiens berühmtem, aber umstrittenem Doppel-WM-Triumph von 1934 und 1938. Und dann waren da noch die drei brasilianischen Kapitäne, die 58, 62 und 70 Weltmeister wurden. Und in neuerer Zeit der verehrte italienische Torwart Gianluigi Buffon. Sie wurden zu Legenden auf der größten Bühne des Fußballs.

programme.title: Im Rampenlicht - Football’s Greatest Stage - Gerd Müller & Oliver Kahn
programme.desc: Episode 4: Gerd Müller war ein Fußballer für das Volk, eine ultimative Geschichte des Engagements. Marcello Lippi - mit der Aufgabe, Italiens Schicksal zu verbessern - beschert den Azzurri 2006 einen berühmten Sieg. Der deutsche Torwart Oliver Kahn war 2002 Held und Bösewicht, aber wir müssen ins Jahr 1966 zurückkehren, um wahre Heldentaten auf der größten Bühne des Fußballs zu erleben.

programme.title: Im Rampenlicht - Football’s Greatest Stage - Pele & Didier Deschamps
programme.desc: Episode 5: Die Geschichte von Pelé, der im Alter von 17 Jahren den Weltpokal an sich gerissen hat, ist Legende. Und wir alle wissen, was wir danach gemacht haben. An der Schwelle zur Wiedervereinigung triumphierte Westdeutschland 1990, und einige französische Legenden verhalfen ihrem Land 1998 zum Gipfel des WM-Ruhmes. Das alles gibt es in dieser Ausgabe von Football's Greatest Stage.

programme.title: Im Rampenlicht - Football’s Greatest Stage - Eusebio & Neymar
programme.desc: Episode 6: Wenn man an portugiesische Fußballstars denkt, denkt man immer an Cristiano Ronaldo. Aber was ist mit Eusébio? Er war ein Weltcup-Star. Und dann war da noch der brillante italienische Brains Trust von Vittorio Pozzo und Giuseppe Meazza. Kann der Fußball ohne seine Stars überleben? Brasilien ist 2014 sicherlich nicht ohne Neymar ausgekommen. So viele Geschichten - auf der größten Bühne des Fußballs.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Eine Chemiedoktorandin wird erschossen aufgefunden. Wie sich herausstellt, war sie eine Drogenköchin, die für das Kartell von Adan Dirba gearbeitet hat. Doch dieser ist ebenfalls tot.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Die Ermittler bekommen ein Video zugespielt, das den Mord an einer jungen Frau zeigt. Offenbar handelt es sich um einen Serienmörder ..

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Am Ufer der Seine wird die Leiche von Corinne Vidal gefunden. Die junge Kriminalpsychologin Chloé Saint-Laurent und Commandant Matthieu Pérac müssen die Identität des Opfers klären.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Der Krebsarzt und Forscher Thomas Cavélain wurde vergiftet. Auf seinen Vater Robert, ebenfalls erfolgreicher Krebsarzt, ist ebenso eine Giftattacke verübt worden. Matthieu und sein Team stoßen bei Ermittlungen auf den Wunderheiler Maxime Dazor. Es stellt sich heraus, dass Maxime und Robert sich gemeinsam um die todkranke Claire Chacot kümmerten, sich aber beide nicht ausstehen konnten. Die Krankpflegerin Jeanne verheimlicht ein dunkles Geheimnis.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Vor sieben Jahren tauchte der entführte Sohn von Alain Farge wieder auf. Als seine Leiche in der Kanalisation auftaucht, behauptet Alain, dass sein Sohn Stéphane, der eigentlich Tristane heißt, noch lebt. Er soll vor sieben Jahren einer Sekte entflohen sein, aber ist Tristane wirklich der vorgibt zu sein.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Juliette Padovani, Ehefrau des Kunsthändlers Vincent, wird ermordet an ihrem Pool gefunden. Ihr Ehemann ist verschwunden, und ihr Stiefsohn Anthony benimmt sich äußerst verdächtig.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Adèle hat Argos in ihrer Gewalt, was sie ihren Kollegen allerdings verheimlicht. Trotz ihres momentanen Krankenstandes beteiligt sie sich an den Ermittlungen im Fall des vermissten Hugo Fournier.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Hugos Entführung wurde von seinen Eltern inszeniert. Sie erhofften sich dadurch neue Fortschritte im Fall ihrer verschwundenen Tochter Laura.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Auf einem Weingut sollen Rocher und sein Team auf Geheiß von Diane Baranski ein Teambuilding-Seminar absolvieren. Doch daraus wird nichts..

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Claire Chassaigne stürmt bewaffnet die Weinverkostung, verletzt dabei Robin Tomasi und nimmt die übrigen Anwesenden als Geiseln. Adèle gelingt es, Rocher zu verständigen..

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: 30 Jahre nach seinem Vorgänger Antoine Zidi stürzt sich Martin Lepage, Leiter des Raumfahrtforschungszentrums, von genau derselben Brücke in den Tod - so scheint es.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Der Boxtrainer Paul wird ermordet in der Boxhalle aufgefunden, in der er seinen Bruder, den angehenden Champion Clément, gecoacht hat. Zuerst gerät Cléments Erzrivale Gaël Perez in Verdacht..

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Vincent Sérail hat einen Mordanschlag auf seine Familie nur knapp überlebt, seine Eltern wurden getötet. Die Tat erinnert an die Verbrechen von David Weber. Allerdings ist er inhaftiert..

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Richterin Nicole Marceau ist aufgeflogen: Um sich am Justizsystem zu rächen, das ihre Kindheit ruinierte, manipulierte sie vermutlich sämtliche Fälle, die sie je bearbeitet hat.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Die verbrannte Leiche eines Arztes wird aufgefunden. Das Team ermittelt, dass der Mann vor 15 Jahren einige Jugendliche aus einem brennenden Auto befreite - für Adèle eine klare Verbindung..

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Argos' Anwalt wurde getötet - und Adèle befindet sich bei der Leiche. Sie beteuert ihre Unschuld, doch Rocher hat zunächst Zweifel, denn die belastenden Indizien häufen sich.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Das Leben von Adèle hat sich in den letzten Jahren massiv gewandelt: Sie wohnt mit Gabriel in der Nähe von Marseille und ist in einer Kinderpsychiatrie tätig. Sie hält Fach-Vorträge und ..

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Gemeinsam mit Adèle findet sich Rocher in einem Keller wieder. Als einer der beiden Entführer seinen Partner plötzlich tötet, nutzt Rocher die Chance, den anderen anzugreifen.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Die 35-jährige Margot Flaundre wird vermisst. Adéle und Rocher gehen dem Fall nach und treffen auf Margots paranoide Tante, die ihnen wirre Geschichten über einen Fluch erzählt..

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Ein älterer Mann wird zu Hause von einem Unbekannten erstochen - einzige Zeugin: seine kleine Enkeltochter.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Adèle, Rocher und Jess ermitteln im Fall von Elodie Auclerc: Sie hat vor vier Jahren ihr Kind verloren, das von einem Auto erfasst und getötet worden ist. Der Fahrer konnte unerkannt vom Tatort fliehen.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Die 15-jährige Schülerin Emilie wird heimtückisch ermordet, außerdem entfernt ihr der Täter beide Augen.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Als in einer Hütte im Wald zwei Leichen gefunden werden, stehen die Ermittler zunächst vor einem Rätsel..

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Rocher hat seine Gehirnoperation zwar überlebt, liegt aber seitdem im Koma. Adèle erzählt ihm bei ihren Besuchen immer wieder von ihren aktuellen Ermittlungen..

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Rocher ist völlig verwirrt, als er auf einem Friedhof eine Frau entdeckt, die ihm bekannt vorkommt. Er ist sich sicher, dass es sich um seine ehemals große Liebe aus Jugendtagen handelt.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: In ganz Frankreich tauchen Pakete mit Leichenteilen auf. Eines davon landet auch bei Chloé, die sich gerade mit Lili in ihrem neuen Haus einrichtet.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Georges Vitalis entführt seine elfjährige Enkelin Alice und wird bei der Ergreifung schwer verletzt. In seiner Wohnung findet man außerdem eine Leiche.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Die Kleinkriminelle Jessica Serrano wird erschlagen in ihrer Wohnung gefunden. Bei der Leiche liegen 100.000 Euro in bar.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Ein Amoklauf an einer Universität fordert mehrere Tote und zahlreiche Verletzte. Der Attentäter selbst landet mit einem Kopfschuss im Krankenhaus und stirbt kurze Zeit später.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Der Menschenrechtsaktivist Renaud Carpentier wurde offenbar vom Dach eines brennenden Hotels gestoßen.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Sechs Monaten ist Laura Vautier schon verschwunden als sich der Entführer erneut bei ihrem Vater meldet. Matthieu und sein Team nehmen die Ermittlungen wieder auf.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Eine Frau wurde vergewaltigt und ermordet. Eine DNA-Spuren auf der Leiche scheint zum Täter zu führen. Der behauptet allerdings, dass er mit dem Tod nichts zu tun hat.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Der neue Fall führt Matthieu und sein Team auf den Spielplatz einer Schule, wo die Leiche der Direktorin Nathalie gefunden wurde. Sie war durch eine künstliche Befruchtung mit einem nicht lebensfähigen Baby schwanger.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: An den Pariser Docks wird der Student Raphael Mirmont tot in einem Container gefunden. Offenbar wurde er erschlagen. Seine Verlobte ist völlig aufgelöst - schließlich wollten die beiden bald heiraten.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Im Krematorium wird die Leiche einer Frau gefunden, die nicht für eine Einäscherung vorgesehen war. Anhand der Zähne wird sie schnell als Sandrine Dewit identifiziert.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Die Leiche einer Frau wird in einem Park gefunden. Das Opfer, das farbige Kontaktlinsen und eine Perücke trug, wurde erwürgt. Die Autopsie ergibt, dass sich die Frau erst kürzlich zahlreichen Gesichts-Operationen unterzogen hatte.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Am Set einer TV-Serie wird die Schauspielerin Maryline tot aufgefunden. Sie war aus dem Cast geflogen, da sie dem Druck nicht standhielt, und wollte angeblich ihre letzte Gage einfordern.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Vor Lamarcks Haustür wird ein Mädchen angefahren. Anhand des Nummernschildes können Matthieu und sein Team den Fahrer ausfindig machen - so scheint es, doch sie stoßen auf schmutzige Geheimnisse.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Stéphanie Lavaudant wird von ihrer Nachbarin Alexandra tot in ihrer Badewanne gefunden. Alexandra erzählt Chloé und Matthieu, dass Stéphanie im Urlaub bei dem Tsunami von 2004 ihren Mann verloren hat.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Ein Mathematiklehrer wird an seiner Schule ermordet und übel zugerichtet. Zunächst gibt es keine Hinweise, doch dann stoßen Matthieu und sein Team auf weitere Morde, die die gleichen Merkmale aufweisen.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: In einem Waldstück liegt eine mumifizierte Männerleiche. Eine DNA-Analyse ergibt, dass es sich um einen Umweltaktivisten mit Zwillingsbruder handelt. Aber stimmt das.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Marie Saurier wird tot am Rande einer Autobahn gefunden. Offenbar starb sie durch eine Alkoholvergiftung.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Freds Bekannte Miriam taucht bei einem Treffen der Anonymen Alkoholiker auf. Sie behauptet, ihre Tochter gesehen zu haben. Doch Miriam hat gar keine Tochter.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Der ruppige Kommandant Rocher ist der neue Vorgesetzte von Fred, Lamarck und Hyppolite. Als eine grausame Mordserie Paris erschüttert, ist Rocher dringend auf Chloés Hilfe angewiesen.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Ein Fußgänger entdeckt die Leiche einer jungen Frau: Da die Tote keine Spuren von Gewalt aufweist, geht der Gerichtsmediziner davon aus, dass sie gefangen gehalten wurde.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Alice Legendre wird mit schweren Stichverletzungen gefunden. Sie trägt ihr Hochzeitskleid. Einen ähnlichen Fall behandelte Chloé vor 15 Jahren.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Dimitri Saillan wird erschossen auf einem Pariser Friedhof gefunden. Als Polizist getarnt war er in der Metropole unterwegs, um einen Vergewaltiger zu überführen, wie das Team herausfindet.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Die Leiche der Journalistin Ava Polignac treibt in der Seine. Jemand hat der Frau ein Jagdmesser in die Leber gerammt. Offenbar hielt sich Ava vor ihrem Tod versteckt.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: In einem Wohnkomplex wird die Leiche von François Rénier gefunden. Offenbar hat der Mann über einen sehr langen Zeitraum die Familie Maréchal beobachtet.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Der Journalist Adrien Keller verbrachte 700 Tage in der Gefangenschaft kolumbianischer Terroristen. Nun will er sein neues Buch vorstellen, doch kurz vor der Pressekonferenz wird er ermordet ..

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Die Fotografin Jeanne Krakowski wurde in ihrem Loft erdrosselt. Scheinbar kannte sie ihren Angreifer, denn es gibt keine Einbruchsspuren.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Camille Janvier wurde in ihrer mondänen Villa am Pariser Stadtrand zu Tode geprügelt. Ihr Ehemann Nicolas ist nicht zu erreichen, der gemeinsame Sohn Theo spurlos verschwunden.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Chloé kämpft immer noch mit dem Verlust ihres Babys, doch dann wartet ein neuer Fall auf sie: Der Kellner Laurent Mérieux wurde mit mehreren Messerstichen getötet.

programme.title: Profiling Paris
programme.desc: Chloé besucht ein Kriminologen-Seminar, das sich bald als lebensgefährlich entpuppt: Auf ihrem Zimmer findet sie eine Leiche.

programme.title: Profiling Paris

Aber auch Krista ist in ernste Probleme geraten. Thomas Kramer spinnt intrigenreich für Sascha die Fäden, um gemeinsam die Macht im Springer Konzern an sich zu reißen. Mit Ulla Wagner als Wahlhelferin gedenkt er den Thron des Veldeners Bürgermeister zu erklimmen.

programme.title: Ein Schloss am Wörthersee
programme.desc: Lennie steckt wieder einmal in großen Zahlungsschwierigkeiten und jetzt will die Bank auch noch den Geldhahn zudrehen, wäre da nicht Krista, die, ohne Lennies Wissen, für seine Schulden bürgt, um im Schloss in weiterer Folge mitreden zu können. Dr. Willibald Kalk und seine Gattin Antje können seinen hochnäsigen Arztkollegen Dr. Kurt Salk nicht leiden. Doch beide haben im Schlosshotel Velden gebucht. Einmal Kalk, einmal Salk. Kein Wunder also, wenn die Empfangsdamen des Hotels verzweifeln und es zu einer fatalen Doppelbuchung kommt.

programme.title: Ein Schloss am Wörthersee
programme.desc: Fast selbstmörderisch turnt eine hübsche, junge Frau über die hohen Baugerüste des Schlosshotels. Petra, die Tierärztin des Veldener Tierparks, erkundet neugierig die große Baustelle des noblen Hotels. Lennie ist fasziniert vom Glanz Petras hübscher Augen. Ein klein wenig verliebt holt er Petra vom Gerüst herunter und führt sie durchs Schlosshotel. Dabei erfährt er von ihren ärgsten Sorgen: Bürgermeister Grasshofer will den Tierpark schließen. Ein prominenter Gast sucht ein Quartier im Hause von Lennie Berger. Sonja Vorena (Sona Ghazarian), eine der berühmtesten Opernsängerinnen der Welt, will sich auf eine Gala in Triest vorbereiten. Doch der Baustellenlärm stört ihre Gesangsproben.

programme.title: Ein Schloss am Wörthersee
programme.desc: Auch Krista Springer kann in finanzielle Sorgen geraten. Die rasche Expansion ihres Reisebüros verschlingt viel Geld. Und in ihrer Gutmütigkeit hat Krista auch für einen großen Kredit für Lennies Schlosshotel gebürgt. Jetzt wird sie von ihren Hausbanken unter Druck gesetzt. Krista gerät unter Zugzwang bei einem großen Geschäft einen Partner in Amerika zu finden. Doch der Reisebüromogul Teddy Foreman interessiert sich mehr für Australia als für Austria und schöne Frauen als für kleine Geschäfte. Erst als ihm Fotos von der hübschen Krista gezeigt werden, fliegt Teddy in eine Stadt mit einem für ihn unaussprechlichen Namen - Klagenfurt.

programme.title: Ein Schloss am Wörthersee
programme.desc: Kunsthistorikerin Gertrud Nevermann ist immer noch auf der Suche nach dem verschollenen Van Gogh Gemälde. Denn Lennie hat, der alten Schinken überdrüssig, den wahren Wert nicht erkannt und sie teilweise verschenkt oder verkauft. Also werden die beiden Hausdiener Josip und Malec auf Bilderjagd geschickt. Der Van Gogh muss zurück ins Schlosshotel. Gertrud wagt sich bei der Suche nach dem Bild sogar in ein Männerkloster und zu Nina Hagen auf die Bühne.

programme.desc: Lennie Berger ist tot. Seine Ex-Frau Elke wird von der Nachricht überrascht, als die Innenarchitektin einen verlockenden Auftrag in Paris annehmen möchte. Ihr Sohn Max erbt das Schlosshotel und Mama einen ganzen Pack voller Sorgen. Auf Elkes Wunsch bestellt das Gericht zunächst deren Bruder Leo Laxeneder zum Nachlassverwalter. Auch Lennies Ex-Freundinnen Krista Springer, Anja Weber und Ulla Wagner versuchen das Schlosshotel zu retten. Max setzt aber auf einen anderen Mann: Seinen Freund und Lebensretter Andrè Blondeau. Doch der ist nicht mehr in Euro-Disney bei Paris, sondern in Thailand. Die Lage scheint hoffnungslos.

programme.title: Ein Schloss am Wörthersee
programme.desc: Nachlassverwalter Leo hat die Sache wirklich nicht sehr geschickt angestellt. Als Portier getarnt, versuchte er sich mehr Informationen zu verschaffen. Als auch noch Leos eifersüchtige Ehefrau Gisela auftaucht, scheint der endgültig verloren. Lennies Sohn Max ergreift nun selbst die Initiative. Er schickt die Hausburschen Josip und Malec nach Thailand auf die Suche nach Andrè, denn nur der Franzose kann das Schlosshotel retten. Doch auf der thailändischen Badeinsel Phuket erwarten die tollpatschigen Hausburschen viele Überraschungen. Schließlich kommt Elke Berger selbst an den Wörthersee, um Leo zu unterstützen und das marode Schlosshotel zu retten.

Hoffnung, Zweifel und eine immer mehr um sich greifende ökologische Katastrophe stehen einer sich blind und taub stellenden doktrinären Staatsmacht gegenüber, die Tatsachen verleugnet.

programme.desc: Der Film geht dem Problem nach, dass zu wenige Frauen ein technisches Hochschulstudium absolvieren.
